statement: 2177 gives theta_1=exp(-v/2)dr after u=0, but it does not by itself identify dr as areal, isotropic, or another parent-owned radial coordinate.
implication: this is why the 2PN comparison can be mixed-gauge.

statement: Areal Schwarzschild gauge requires angular area element R^2 dOmega^2 while reciprocal radial leg has B=(1-2GM/(c^2R))^-1.
implication: MTS must state whether r is area radius or supply the isotropic-to-areal map.

statement: PPN beta/gamma are normally read in isotropic-like coordinates; kappa_v=0 belongs to that lapse gauge.
implication: beta=1 cannot be inferred from an areal-coordinate x^2 coefficient without transforming gauge.

statement: B=exp(-v)=1/A is exact Schwarzschild radial gauge when r is areal and A=1-2GM/(c^2r).
implication: the reciprocal branch is not killed by the isotropic 2PN warning.

statement: The parent action/readout must choose either: areal reciprocal gauge plus PPN transform, or isotropic gauge with non-reciprocal spatial factor.
implication: choosing both in the same coordinate causes the +1/2 residual.
